column1: # Golden table for ErrorLadderImpl (docs/design/m2-playback-core.md §4.3). One line per (signal, context) case.
# rule     = the design row (L1..L44) or global rule (G-gate, G-timeout, G-limiter) the case exercises. Every L1..L44 must appear.
#            L0 (stale tuneId) is the controller's filter and never reaches the ladder.
# signal   = Http <status> <origin> | Network <kind> before|after | ReconnectExhausted <status|-> bytes|nobytes | Html |
#            TinyBody <n> | FormatIsHls | FormatUnrecognized | Pcr <deltaMs> | BehindLive | Parsing media|manifest |
#            AudioWrite | ResourcesReclaimed | Stuck <type> | Stall <StallKind> | LiveEnded | Credentials transient|permanent |
# context  = key=value overrides of the default context (ErrorLadderTableTest.ctx): ms (since tune), firstFrame, live, archive,
#            format, xtream, baseCount, output, reResolveAllowed, attempts, tunneling, passthrough, passthroughMime, decoderMode,
#            swVideo, uaFallback, backup, compat, active, max, account, prior (feed the same signal N times first), and every
#            LadderCounters field (uaTried = uaFallbackTried). ffmpeg supports audio/ac3, audio/eac3, audio/mpeg-L2. Jitter is off.
# expected = ErrorLadderImpl.describe(decision): Fail(CODE) for failures, the data-class toString otherwise.
# ---- L2-L6 connection limits in the zap window / before first media
# ---- L7 mid-playback 403/458/509 (token expiry), then the L4/L6 rules
# ---- L16-L18 network before the first byte
# ---- L21/L22 bodies that are not a stream
# ---- L31-L33 audio decoders and audio stalls
# ---- global: stream switch timeout (15 s without first media)
